note: Every file allowed to name a model provider's host, and why. A new file is a new model sink: add it here (reviewer-2 signs off), and it must call kernel/door. Files under retrofit_pending still reach providers directly today and move behind the door in the retrofit. audio_only files name a provider host for audio and carry no prompt: each says what covers it.
control: The control is the egress firewall (K6 and the host): the box lets only the gateway reach provider hosts. This list is a smoke test that catches the honest mistake in review.

not_inference.core/vault/rotate.js: rotates a provider API key; sends no prompt

audio_only.local/voice/providers.js: Speech endpoints (Deepgram listen, OpenAI and ElevenLabs transcription, text to speech). Audio goes in or out, so there is no prompt to put through call(). The text that is spoken goes through the door's sanitiser first (local/voice/index.js speakable); the key goes only to the provider's own host; the egress firewall covers the rest.
